title: Gotrade Daily: Broadcom Leads AI Earnings Night
summary: Broadcom, HPE and Snowflake report tonight. AI earnings set the tone while oil above $100 lifts energy names.
body_markdown:
### Oil tops $100, energy offers cover


Brent rose more than 6% to around $100 and WTI to $91 on Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz risk. **Chevron ([CVX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cvx/) )** and Exxon each gained about 3%. Energy is moving opposite to tech.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


US markets were not open when this Watchlist was built, so the figures above use Tuesday's closes plus catalyst context. The early tone leans cautious: tech soft ahead of earnings, energy firm with oil. Watch Nasdaq futures into the bell as a risk-appetite signal.


## Macro Note 📝


Bond yields are rising and a hawkish Fed tone on rates still lingers. The US dollar is firmer and gold is easing. High oil is the inflation wildcard that could keep rate expectations tight.


## Conclusion


Tonight is an AI-earnings test night, and Broadcom leads it. AI-demand guidance from AVGO, HPE and Snowflake could set the direction for the whole tech complex over the next few days. Energy is the natural hedge if oil stays hot.
